fact: As of May 2021 Liberia had no wide-scale national backbone, though the Monrovia-Buchanan route had been completed via aerial fibre largely by Orange.
title: ProICT: Strengthening the Core Capabilities of the Liberian Telecommunications Authority (LTA) - Optical Fiber Cable (OFC) Report and Recommendations
